resources.string: Choose the folder Command & Conquer Generals Zero Hour is installed in (the one with INIZH.big). Its files are copied once into this app\'s own storage so the game can read them; the original files are not changed.

Zero Hour is there, but not the original Command & Conquer Generals it needs. Copy Generals\' .big files into a folder named ZH_Generals inside the Zero Hour folder (its Textures.big must be there), then choose the Zero Hour folder again.
